limitations_and_integrity: The original geometric first-order source appeared in print in 1996; 2009-12-11 is its day-verified electronic public posting, not its original publication date. The scalar positive-density maximal-spacing limit is prior work (Barbe 1992; Antonik et al. 2013) and is not claimed as new. This finding asserts the joint geometric cap-height/location marked Poisson limit under positive smooth curvature and a finite collection of isolated nondegenerate curvature-density ratio minima. No higher-dimensional, constant-ratio, degenerate-minimum, or finite-sample calibration theorem; all historical priority is provisional. Numerical checks are illustrations, not infinite proofs.
title: Marked Gumbel extremes for nonoptimally sampled smooth planar ovals
